name: exterior-face-lightmap-verify-off
description: EXTERIOR-FACE-LIGHTMAP — the BEFORE arm: same scenario as exterior-face-lightmap-verify.json but forces exteriorFaceLightmapFallback OFF in setup (before the tier switches to 'realistic' and the baked-GI maps first attach), so every shell face keeps the atlas uv1 it had before the fix and an EXTERIOR face still samples the INTERIOR face's irradiance. The [probe] wall JSON should show uv1Range entirely in [0,1] here. Run with SHOT_GPU=1 and diff each numbered screenshot against the matching one from exterior-face-lightmap-verify.json.

steps.name: capture-init
steps.eval: (() => { window.__ext = { logs: [], probes: [] }; const info = console.info.bind(console); const warn = console.warn.bind(console); console.info = (...a) => { const s = String(a[0]); if (s.includes('lightmaps:')) window.__ext.logs.push(s); info(...a) }; console.warn = (...a) => { const s = String(a[0]); if (s.includes('lightmaps:')) window.__ext.logs.push(s); warn(...a) } })()

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('exteriorFaceLightmapFallback', false); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false) })()

steps.name: pin-device-class
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store; s.getState().setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setState({ setDeviceClass: () => {} }) })()

steps.name: pose-living-near-down
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(10.9, 2.3); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(-0.18) })()

steps.name: probe-wall
steps.eval: (() => { const { scene, camera, raycaster } = window.__three; const rc = new raycaster.constructor(); rc.setFromCamera({ x: -0.75, y: 0.2 }, camera); const hits = rc.intersectObjects(scene.children, true).filter(h => { const o = h.object; if (!o.visible || !o.isMesh) return false; const m = Array.isArray(o.material) ? o.material[0] : o.material; if (!m || m.opacity === 0 || m.colorWrite === false) return false; if ((m.transmission ?? 0) > 0) return false; return true }); const h = hits[0]; if (!h) { console.log('[probe]', JSON.stringify({ name: null })); return } const m = Array.isArray(h.object.material) ? h.object.material[0] : h.object.material; const uv1 = h.object.geometry.getAttribute('uv1'); let uv1Range = null; if (uv1) { let mn = Infinity, mx = -Infinity; for (let i = 0; i < uv1.count; i++) { mn = Math.min(mn, uv1.getX(i), uv1.getY(i)); mx = Math.max(mx, uv1.getX(i), uv1.getY(i)) } uv1Range = [+mn.toFixed(4), +mx.toFixed(4)] } const bb = h.object.geometry.boundingBox || (h.object.geometry.computeBoundingBox(), h.object.geometry.boundingBox); const result = { name: h.object.name || h.object.type, dist: +h.distance.toFixed(2), point: [+h.point.x.toFixed(2), +h.point.y.toFixed(2), +h.point.z.toFixed(2)], size: [+(bb.max.x - bb.min.x).toFixed(2), +(bb.max.y - bb.min.y).toFixed(2), +(bb.max.z - bb.min.z).toFixed(2)], color: m.color ? '#' + m.color.getHexString() : null, hasVisLightmap: m.userData?.visLightmap === true, uv1Range }; window.__ext.probes.push(result); console.log('[probe]', JSON.stringify(result)) })()
